summary: Connect stakeholder evidence to climate funding proposals with practical TCFD, engagement planning and reporting exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: TCFD training explains how climate-related financial risks and stakeholder evidence inform climate-finance decisions. It is designed for practitioners, project developers and sustainability officers preparing or assessing climate proposals. Learners practise assessing project readiness, mapping stakeholders, designing consultations and linking feedback to proposal evidence and reporting for funding decisions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who develop, assess, finance or report on climate-related projects and need to connect stakeholder evidence to funding decisions.
modules: Theory of Change and Finance Accountability
prerequisites: Working familiarity with climate-related projects, project finance or stakeholder engagement is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
